cohort: 1200 pregnant women between 24-32 weeks of gestation were included in the study.
finding: Elevated total cholesterol, triglycerides, and LDL levels were significantly associated with early preterm labor and increased NICU admissions.
gest_age: 24-32 weeks of gestation (at inclusion); outcomes related to early preterm, late preterm, and term gestational ages at delivery.
